title: Costa Rica Escape
name: Costa Rica Escape
stays: Arenal Observatory Lodge · Fonda Vela · Tamarindo Diria
p1: Seven days and six nights across Arenal, Monteverde and Tamarindo, curated for the traveler who wants wonder without the work. Waterfalls and hot springs by the volcano, the cloud forest canopy, and a slow finish on the Pacific coast.
p2: Private transportation, transfers and a professional guide are arranged before you land in Liberia. You simply arrive, exhale and savor it, alongside a small circle of travelers who will feel like old friends by the farewell dinner.
storyImg: A traveler strolling the beach at golden hour
presText: Your first two nights are at Arenal Observatory Lodge, on the volcano’s shoulder. Day one ends with a 530-step walk to La Fortuna Waterfall for a swim, then dinner at EcoTermales Hot Springs.
